tipo_canto: Territorial sound as encountering another duck
comentarios:
This audio is a fragment edited for "Merganetta - A Short Film", a documentary by colombian audiovisual artist León Felipe Jiménez. It has been panned and I used a moderate high pass filter and an agressive low pass filter, nevertheless I was careful to use these filters only til the point they wouldn't change the tone of the duck's sound. 

This quacking corresponds to a male duck leading the female and 1 offspring river upwards, the male went first to explore as they perceived the presence of another duck (a toy of a duck we used to call their attention). The male would make this noise as he approached the intruder fake duck. Though the male seemed to be concerned about the intruder's presence, he wasn't scared.
